# Sidestream

> Sidestream is a Mac panel for Adobe Premiere Pro that lets editors search, preview, and download YouTube videos, songs, overlays, b-roll, references, tutorials, and audio without leaving Premiere.

## Canonical pages

- [Sidestream landing page](https://sidestream.tv/): product overview, feature proof, pricing, and Mac installer download entry point.

## Product facts

- Product name: Sidestream.
- Category: Adobe Premiere Pro panel / Mac editing workflow utility.
- Platform: macOS with Adobe Premiere Pro.
- Core workflow: search YouTube by keyword or pasted link, preview results, then download video or audio assets for editing.
- Current offer: 10 free downloads total at up to 1080p; Pro at $9.99/month for unlimited 4K downloads; Sidestream Unlimited as a $39.99 one-time paid upgrade for unlimited 4K downloads and Instagram, TikTok, X, and LinkedIn posts. Pro does not include social downloads. Configured regional one-time offers may differ.
- Sidestream Unlimited device policy: up to two active production devices, with no limit on device moves; when both slots are occupied, a confirmed move deactivates one previous device.
- Download endpoint: https://sidestream.tv/api/download.
- Update endpoint: https://sidestream.tv/api/releases/latest.
- Paid sequence: Upgrade opens the plan chooser; select Pro monthly or Unlimited one-time, authenticate with Google, then pay through server-selected Stripe Checkout.
- Lead capture endpoint: https://sidestream.tv/api/download-lead.

## Crawl guidance

- The HTML landing page is the preferred source for public product information.
- `/api/download` and `/api/download-lead` are functional endpoints, not content pages.
- Use the page title, meta description, Open Graph tags, and SoftwareApplication structured data for concise summaries and citations.
